units.source_text: 另外，女人擦拭身体的方法，也特别仔细，仔细得过分了。

en.t: Besides, the way the woman wiped her body was unusually meticulous, meticulous to an excessive degree.

units.source_text: 先用濡湿的毛巾粗粗地擦一下，然后，用力把毛巾绞得像木板似的干硬，简直像要刮掉玻璃上的雾气似的猛擦。

en.t: First she gave herself a rough wipe with a wet towel; then she wrung the towel with all her strength until it was as stiff and hard as a board, and scrubbed fiercely, almost as if she were trying to scrape the mist off a pane of glass.

units.source_text: 那份有节奏的刺激，暗示着早晨的到来，慢慢地开始诱导他进入难耐的睡眠。

en.t: That rhythmic stimulation suggested the arrival of morning, and slowly began to draw him into an unbearable sleep.
